summary: A short note on Con Anima, a group that was founded in 1995 and gave a number of concerts between then and 1999, mostly at St Mary's Chapel in Blairs, Aberdeen. The note contains no further detail about the group's membership, repertoire or later history.
one_line: Con Anima, founded in 1995, gave concerts mostly at St Mary's Chapel, Blairs, Aberdeen until 1999.
key_facts: Con Anima gave a number of concerts between 1995 and 1999.
Most of Con Anima's concerts in that period were held at St Mary's Chapel, Blairs, Aberdeen.
